Name: Butterfly Bow Bear Ears Replacer
Author: zzinq
Description:
Feel free to use in your own replacer hat package as long as you give credit to me <:
This is a very simple mod that replaces the butterfly bow with cute lil' bear ears instead. Ears made by me.
[b][i]No other hats are replaced. Every other hat is vanilla.

[/i][/b]If you'd like to replace the other hats with other non-vanilla hats you'll have to do that yourself!
